input_paths.title: Input Paths
input_paths.description: List of input paths where the image data is stored as OME-Zarrs. Should point to the parent folder containing one or many OME-Zarr files, not the actual OME-Zarr file. Example: `["/some/path/"]`. This task only supports a single input path. (standard argument for Fractal tasks, managed by Fractal server).

output_path.title: Output Path
output_path.description: This parameter is not used by this task. (standard argument for Fractal tasks, managed by Fractal server).

component.title: Component
component.description: Path to the OME-Zarr image in the OME-Zarr plate that is processed. Example: `"some_plate.zarr/B/03/0"`. (standard argument for Fractal tasks, managed by Fractal server).

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: This parameter is not used by this task. (standard argument for Fractal tasks, managed by Fractal server).

level.title: Level
level.description: Pyramid level of the image to be segmented. Choose `0` to process at full resolution.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Primary channel for segmentation; requires either `wavelength_id` (e.g. `A01_C01`) or `label` (e.g. `DAPI`).

input_ROI_table.title: Input Roi Table
input_ROI_table.description: Name of the ROI table over which the task loops to apply Cellpose segmentation. Examples: `FOV_ROI_table` => loop over the field of views, `organoid_ROI_table` => loop over the organoid ROI table (generated by another task), `well_ROI_table` => process the whole well as one image.

output_ROI_table.title: Output Roi Table
output_ROI_table.description: If provided, a ROI table with that name is created, which will contain the bounding boxes of the newly segmented labels. ROI tables should have `ROI` in their name.

output_label_name.title: Output Label Name
output_label_name.description: Name of the output label image (e.g. `"organoids"`).

use_masks.title: Use Masks
use_masks.description: If `True`, try to use masked loading and fall back to `use_masks=False` if the ROI table is not suitable. Masked loading is relevant when only a subset of the bounding box should actually be processed (e.g. running within `organoid_ROI_table`).

relabeling.title: Relabeling
relabeling.description: If `True`, apply relabeling so that label values are unique for all objects in the well.

model_path.title: Model Path
model_path.description: Full path to the trained RDCNet model

core_count.title: Core Count
core_count.description: How many CPU cores to use

tiling_patch_size.title: Tiling Patch Size
tiling_patch_size.description: Size of tiling patches to process in pixels (zyx?)

tiling_border.title: Tiling Border
tiling_border.description: Overlap between patches to use (we think)

labels_fill_holes.title: Labels Fill Holes
labels_fill_holes.description: Whether wholes in label masks should be filled

labels_size_threshold.title: Labels Size Threshold
labels_size_threshold.description: RDCNET parameter, always set to True?

labels_keep_largest.title: Labels Keep Largest
labels_keep_largest.description: RDCNET parameter, something about overlapping labels?

Channel.title: Channel
Channel.description: A channel which is specified by either `wavelength_id` or `label`.

wavelength_id.title: Wavelength Id
wavelength_id.description: Unique ID for the channel wavelength, e.g. `A01_C01`.
